builds.name: Leveling — Arms two-hander (Mortal Strike at 40, Enrage last)
builds.summary: Two-handed Arms leveling revised from the fight lab on 2026-09-26: Improved Rend, Deflection, Improved Charge and Improved Overpower first, Deep Wounds at 20, Impale and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, Bloodthrill, Weaponmaster and Mortal Strike at 40 (the one talent worth 40% of time per kill), then Fury for Cruelty, Unbridled Wrath, Blood Craze and Enrage. Charge, Bloodrage, Battle Shout, Victory Rush, Mortal Strike, Overpower after dodges, Rend, Execute under 20%, Heroic Strike with spare rage; bandage and eat between fights.

core.why: Worth +40% time per kill at 60 in the sim (the rotation has nothing else to spend rage on); reaching 30 Arms points by 40 is the whole point of the order.
+5% crit: +9-11% per kill in the sim through Deep Wounds, Overpower and Enrage procs.
Overpower on a Rended mob without waiting for a dodge: +9-10% in the sim.
Crit bleeds: +7-9% in the sim.
+10% damage after being hit, which happens constantly solo: +7-10% in the sim.
Overpower crits: +5-6%.
+3% crit with an axe or polearm: +5%.
+2 rage per white hit with a two-hander: +4%.
+5% parry: +3% per kill and fewer deaths; also the cheapest way to 30 Arms points.

alternatives: Improved Execute 2 + Boundless Rage 1
Improved Heroic Strike 3
flex.why: Blood Craze measures 1-2% (health after crits); Improved Execute and Improved Heroic Strike measured under 1% in the sim.

alternatives: Improved Slam
Improved Hamstring
flex.why: A tier filler on the way to Mortal Strike: none of the three does anything measurable single-target.

notes: Tier unlock levels: tier 2 at 15, tier 3 at 20, tier 4 at 25, tier 5 at 30, tier 6 at 35, tier 7 at 40.
Spearing Strike (16-pt, extra damage vs. Giants/Dragonkin, dismounts) is skipped: leveling mobs are mostly Beasts/Humanoids.

This allocation is the optimizer's (opt-arms-2h-raid-leveling-st) with the order fixed by hand: the optimizer buys Cruelty first and reaches Mortal Strike at 45, which is 14% slower at 40 in the sim; Arms first with Mortal Strike at 40 is within 2% of it at 20-30 and 3% faster at 40. The previous hand draft (Improved Heroic Strike, Improved Slam, Improved Execute, Boundless Rage instead of Deflection 5, Weaponmaster 3, Enrage 5, Blood Craze 3) was 7% slower at 60.

Fight lab (leveling/fightlab/arms-2h-raid.md, 2026-09-29, generated by render_fightlab_sections.py): time per kill at L20/30/40/50/60 = 22/26/28/28/32 s with Classic 1.12 creature stats and quest greens; the optimizer's opt-arms-2h-raid-leveling-st is -2% at 60 and -2% at 30 (negative = faster); race winner over the leveling: cand-arms-r4; top talents at 60: Mortal Strike +15%, Cruelty +6%, Weaponmaster +6%, Bloodthrill +5%; about zero: Boundless Rage, Deflection, Improved Tactical Mastery, Sweeping Strikes. See the Fight lab section of leveling/README.md.
open_questions: Bloodthrill proc rate at max rank (only rank 1 = 2% read) — if it is 10%, taking it before Weaponmaster may be better.
Whether Improved Slam's swing-timer change is real at rank 1; if not, the two Slam points move to Improved Hamstring.
